screen32-a1.glyph: two horizontal lines, the lower one shorter
screen32-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Menu" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a1.convention_relied_on: two/three stacked lines = open the main menu (hamburger) - my reading; the two-line variant is slightly less canonical than three lines
screen32-a1.initial_rationale: no label, but two stacked horizontal lines is a recognizable variant of the hamburger menu convention - common-icon exemption pending the behavioural test
screen32-a1.deciding_evidence: tapping it slid a navigation drawer in from the left, exactly what the menu convention promises; the missing label is not a barrier; tested once on screen1-a1 and carried to this identical control

screen32-a2.description: pill in the header with a sparkle glyph and the words 'Get Plus'
screen32-a2.location: pill in the header with a sparkle glyph and the words 'Get Plus'
screen32-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Get Plus" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a2.initial_rationale: visible words 'Get Plus' with a sparkle; 'Plus' is a product name a first-time user has no way to decode, and nothing says it costs money
screen32-a2.deciding_evidence: tapping opened a paywall ('ChatGPT Plus', 'Upgrade for $19.99', 'Renews monthly') - a paid monthly subscription the words 'Get Plus' never mentioned; tested once on screen1-a2 and carried to this identical control
screen32-a2.recommendation: say what it is and that it is paid, e.g. 'Upgrade to Plus (paid plan)'

screen32-a3.glyph: speech bubble with a checkmark inside
screen32-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Temporary chat" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a3.initial_rationale: a speech bubble with a checkmark inside is not an established convention and carries no label
screen32-a3.deciding_evidence: tapping it silently turned temporary chat off - the heading vanished and the glyph reverted; nothing on the control ever said it was an on/off switch or what it switched; tested once on screen6-a3 and carried to this identical control
screen32-a3.recommendation: make it a labelled toggle, e.g. 'Temporary chat: On' with a visible switch

screen32-a4.description: underlined words at the end of the sentence 'This chat won’t appear in history.'; no record
screen32-a4.location: underlined words at the end of the sentence 'This chat won’t appear in history.'
screen32-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: no strings on the record; not used in the verdict
screen32-a4.initial_rationale: underlined 'Learn more' at the end of 'This chat won't appear in history.'
screen32-a4.deciding_evidence: tapping opened a 'Temporary chat' explanation dialog - more about the sentence it follows; tested once on screen6-a4 and carried to this identical control

screen32-a5.description: dropdown: grey word 'Personalized' followed by a small downward chevron
screen32-a5.location: dropdown: grey word 'Personalized' followed by a small downward chevron
screen32-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Temporary chat personalization Personalized" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a5.initial_rationale: grey word 'Personalized' with a chevron names a state, not what the control changes
screen32-a5.deciding_evidence: only after tapping does a sheet ('Temporary chat settings') explain that it chooses whether the chat uses memory, plugins and custom instructions; tested once on screen6-a5 and carried to this identical control
screen32-a5.recommendation: label it with what it controls, e.g. 'Use my memory: Personalized'

screen32-a6.description: left end of the message composer
screen32-a6.location: left end of the message composer
screen32-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Attachment" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a6.convention_relied_on: plus sign = add / attach - my reading
screen32-a6.initial_rationale: unlabeled plus sign; + = add something is an established convention - exemption pending test
screen32-a6.deciding_evidence: tapping opened an add menu (Camera, Photos, Files, Plugins, Think harder) - adding things to the message, as the plus convention promises; tested once on screen1-a7 and carried to this identical control

screen32-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: no strings on the record; not used in the verdict
screen32-a7.initial_rationale: placeholder 'Write anything' says nothing about what the box is for in this context - the text to be edited, or an instruction about it
screen32-a7.deciding_evidence: the box accepted 'Hello' exactly as it would a request, and nothing on screen said whether to paste the writing to edit or to describe what is wanted; tested once on screen4-a9 and carried to this identical control
screen32-a7.recommendation: replace the placeholder with a specific instruction, e.g. 'Paste the text you want help with'

screen32-a8.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Dictation" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a8.convention_relied_on: microphone = speak instead of typing - my reading
screen32-a8.initial_rationale: unlabeled microphone; microphone = speak / voice input is an established convention - exemption pending test
screen32-a8.deciding_evidence: tapping raised the system request to record audio - the microphone convention held (permission was denied per safety rules); tested once on screen1-a9 and carried to this identical control

screen32-a9.glyph: grey filled circle with an upward arrow
screen32-a9.description: right end of the composer; drawn greyed-out and focusable:false — may be disabled until text is entered
screen32-a9.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Send Message" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen32-a9.convention_relied_on: greyed upward arrow = send, disabled until there is text - my reading
screen32-a9.initial_rationale: greyed upward arrow at the end of a chat composer; send convention, greyed = not yet available - exemption pending test
screen32-a9.deciding_evidence: empty: tapping did nothing; after typing it turned blue and sent - the greyed send convention held; tested once on screen6-a9 and carried to this identical control
